description:
[Deterministic insolvency risk assessment. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Calculates calibrated Altman Z-Score (differentiated for SMEs, manufacturing, and services), Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR), PFN/EBITDA leverage, Current/Quick Ratio, and 12-24 month default probability under the Italian Corporate Crisis Code (CCII, D.Lgs 14/2019).
Usage: Use this tool to predict corporate insolvency risk and assess balance sheet creditworthiness. Do NOT use for earnings manipulation detection (use 'financial_trend_anomaly' instead) or for DCF corporate valuation (use 'dcf_wacc_valuation' instead).
Returns: JSON object with { zScore: number, distressZone: 'SAFE' | 'GREY' | 'DISTRESS', defaultProbabilityPercentage: number, dscr: number, pfnEbitdaRatio: number, solvencyStatus: string, alertSignals: string[] }.
